notes.0x23e040: quad_viewports call target: camera projection setup entry (a0=camera). Its field offsets are the same set in PAL (the research diff was instruction re-scheduling); PAL uses +-256 half-height where USA uses +-224, so the viewport rectangles/centres the mod writes before the call (quad_viewports.prepare) are a 448-line layout: video item for the regional group.
notes.0x2654d8: disc file lookup (global file id -> volume, local index), function entry. PAL adds volume 0 entry 1 (ids <2 -> volume 0) and moves the volume-2 threshold 0xd48 -> 0xe3f (+247), so callers must pass European global ids (FILE_ID). Guarded as reviewed range 0x2654d8+0x58 -> 0x265b78+0x58 (whole 0x50-byte function plus the first two words of the next).
